focus: mimo-05: Measurement-first build order, operator labor and the cost of a day

label: The program costs 2-2.5h operator time, two thirds of it 006's labels; 002 survives zero labor while 003's slice and 006 fail outright without it
Three insertions into BASE's build order: rubric before 006 labels, power line and flip clause before 002's arm interpretation, recorded-use tripwire before R2's wait
One pre-registered kill-line string family across 002/003/005/006; the R2 line 'no recorded OpenCode or Pi verifier use (0 of N)' already fires today
Each arm prints its payload class and planned call count once per session before its first billed call; dollars are cents at vendor-claimed prices and operator minutes and privacy bind instead
The census power line (movable/need-wins/q80) is the soonest usable decision number and must print before the verdict line
